title: Overtime is the strongest single driver
detail: Employees working overtime leave at 30.53% versus 10.44%. Around 35% of all departures are attributable to overtime.

title: Stock options rank first in SHAP importance
detail: Stock option level is the model's strongest single feature, ahead of every satisfaction metric. Stayers average 0.85, leavers 0.53.

title: Attrition is a pay-floor problem
detail: The bottom income quartile produces 45.6% of all attrition from 25% of headcount. Above roughly 5,000 per month the retention return on pay is negligible.

title: Behaviour beats sentiment
detail: Highly satisfied employees who work overtime leave more often than dissatisfied employees who do not.

title: Top 50 watchlist is 5.7x denser in risk
detail: 46 of the top 50 ranked employees genuinely left. Random selection would find 8.

title: No gender disparity detected
detail: Gender flag-rate parity gap is 1.14 percentage points. Gender is excluded from model features.
